what: A write of any one file read by `include_str!`, `include_bytes!` or an `include!` outside the VFS wakes every module group of every crate that expanded any such macro: `core`'s root (110 ms), `gimli` (610 ms), `std`, for a write of thiserror's `private.rs`.
cost: 0.8 s of the first edit of a small project before this lane's fix removed the write; any real edit of an included file still pays it
cause: `Written::included` is not narrowed by which crate read the file, though `Files::included_by` holds it
